scientific_integrity: The entire asserted theorem has an analytic proof. Brute-force rational enumerations are reproducibility checks rather than evidence for universal quantifiers. General non-submodularity was previously recognized; an explicitly related 2024 preprint was later withdrawn and none of its withdrawn conclusions is used.
scientific_limitations: One fixed infected root; independent homogeneous bond transmission on undirected cycles; perfect pre-outbreak vaccines; general graphs, seed laws, correlated contacts, and delayed vaccination are not covered. A complete independent literature verification is not claimed.
title: A sharp transmissibility threshold for submodular vaccination on every cycle
